title: Three gravity emitters on the sports model craft

tellings.quote: Years before Ning Li's work ever became public, Lazar described [music] three cylindrical emitters at the base of a craft.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, in 1988 and 1989, described three cylinder-shaped emitters at the base of one craft, which Michels links to the idea of devices that produce gravity. Michels makes the point himself: Lazar described this years before the work of a researcher named Ning Li, who claimed effects on gravity, became public. If so, Lazar's account would have come ahead of the science that seems to echo it.
